name: Best Slime of my Life
source:
You are a former adventurer trying to pick things back up again after taking an extended break due to the break-up with your ex-wife.

You start where any beginning adventurer would start: by killing slimes. But when you try to slay one, it turns out to be a gelatinous cutie: a sexy woman made out of slime. You end up bonding and eventually dating the seductive slime.

It turns out the slime, Sylphie, feeds on cum. Will your cum be enough for her, or will she end up betraying you for semen just like your ex-wife once did?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4272610/Best_Slime_of_my_Life/]Steam[/url]]
